reconstruction_notes.en: Trace-concept artistic teaching section: continuous gray host-rock block with a unioned network of stout smooth negative tunnel cavities, two open Y junctions and section-edge outlets. The upper section plane removes the roof to expose the cavity/host relationship; dark inner surfaces are original gray palette, not floating branches, worms or filled casts. Nominal 0.32 m block width, path layout and section convention are art choices. No producer species, exact trace dimensions, behavior, excavated specimen or locality asserted.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 遗迹概念艺术教学剖面：连续灰色围岩块内有经合并的粗平滑负空间隧道、两处开放Y节点与剖面边缘出口。上部剖切平面移去顶壁以显露洞腔与围岩关系；深灰内表面为原创配色，不是悬空枝条、虫体或实体充填铸型。0.32米名义块宽、路径布局与剖切方式为美术设定。不指定制造者物种、精确遗迹尺寸、行为、出土标本或地点。
